stem: A machine is supposed to produce random digits. Bob thinks that the machine is not fair and that the probability of it producing the digit 0 is less than $\frac{1}{10}$. In order to test his suspicion he notes the number of times the digit 0 occurs in 30 digits produced by the machine. He carries out a test at the 10% significance level.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: State suitable null and alternative hypotheses.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Find the rejection region for the test.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text: State the probability of a Type I error.

parts.label: (d)
parts.stem: It is now given that the machine actually produces a 0 once in every 40 digits, on average.
parts.text: Find the probability of a Type II error.

parts.label: (e)
parts.text: Explain the meaning of a Type II error in this context.
